title: How to Set Betting Limits
subtitle: Deposit caps, loss limits and cool-off timers — the three controls that keep betting fun instead of risky, and exactly how to turn each one on.
intro: Most bettors lose control of their bankroll one small decision at a time, not in one big moment. A limit set in advance — before the adrenaline of a live IPL over kicks in — removes that decision entirely.

Cricbet99 supports three practical controls: a daily deposit cap, a per-match loss ceiling, and a cool-off period that pauses new bets. All three are applied by your account manager on WhatsApp, usually within minutes of asking.
This guide walks through how each limit works and how bettors typically sequence them — tightest first, then loosened gradually as discipline builds, not the other way around.

features.title: Daily deposit cap
features.desc: Fix a maximum you can add to your wallet per day — once you hit it, further deposits are blocked until the next cycle.

features.title: Per-match loss ceiling
features.desc: Set a stop-loss for a single fixture so a bad session ends there instead of chasing losses into the next market.

features.title: Cool-off period
features.desc: Pause new bets for a period you choose — useful after a losing streak or before a big tournament you'd rather not chase.

features.title: Session time alerts
features.desc: Get a WhatsApp nudge after a set number of hours of active betting so a session doesn't run away from you.

features.title: Applied instantly on request
features.desc: Tell your account manager the cap you want and it's active on your ID right away — no waiting on a settings menu.

features.title: Set up on WhatsApp
features.desc: No forms or settings menus — message your account manager and limits are active within minutes.

faqs.q: How do I actually set a limit on Cricbet99?
faqs.a: Message your account manager on WhatsApp and tell them the daily deposit cap, loss ceiling or cool-off period you want. They confirm it back to you in writing and it's active immediately.

faqs.q: Can I change a limit once it's set?
faqs.a: Yes. Message your account manager and they'll adjust it on your ID. Tightening a limit is always available — if you're unsure, start stricter and loosen it gradually.

faqs.q: What's a reasonable starting daily deposit cap?
faqs.a: Most new players start around 5–10% of their monthly discretionary spend and adjust after a few weeks of tracking their actual habits.

faqs.q: Does a cool-off period close my account?
faqs.a: No. Your ID, balance and history stay intact — a cool-off only blocks new deposits and bets until the period ends.

ctaHeading: Set your limits before your next session.
ctaSub: Message your Cricbet99 account manager on WhatsApp — limits take effect in minutes.
